Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
Motorcycles are not allowed on this portion of the road
Motorcars are allowed on this portion of the road
Motorcycles only are allowed on this portion of the road
Which sign applies to motorcycles with an engine size limit?
Which sign indicates there is a secondary crossroad ahead?
Which sign indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead?
Which sign indicates that the surface of the road is about to change hazardously?
Which sign indicates that the surface of the soft shoulder is about to change?
There is a hazard ahead with police present
There is a bridge ahead with police present
